name: Satyrnaar
summary: In Satyrnaar, Bleakheart satyrs hold an ancient night elf settlement in northeastern Ashenvale. The ruins sit beside the road from Splintertree Post toward Azshara, and their stonework is more intact than that of other satyr camps deep in the forest.

sections.title: A Den of Fel and Shadow
sections.body: You find Satyrnaar northeast of Splintertree Post and southwest of Forest Song. Along with Xavian and Night Run, it is one of Ashenvale’s three chief satyr settlements. Its elven buildings are more intact than those deep in the wilderness, though tents now stand among the broken stone. The Bleakheart satyrs make the trade road east toward Azshara dangerous. They are allied with the Cult of the Dark Strand, whose soulgem lies among the corrupted stones.

faq.answer: Satyrnaar lies in ruin in northeastern Ashenvale, where the Bleakheart satyrs have made their stronghold.
The Bleakheart satyrs occupy Satyrnaar, with tents among the ancient ruins. They are allied with the Cult of the Dark Strand.

faq.q: Why is Satyrnaar significant compared to other satyr ruins?
faq.answer: Satyrnaar, Night Run, and Xavian are Ashenvale’s three chief satyr settlements. Satyrnaar’s buildings are more intact, and it lies beside the road toward Azshara.

faq.q: What is the dark artifact hidden in Satyrnaar?
faq.answer: A soulgem of the Cult of the Dark Strand lies in Satyrnaar. The mortal shadow cult is allied with the Bleakheart satyrs.

angles.text: As a night elf, seeing fel corruption defile ancestral stonework and the cursed remnants of the Highborne occupy it is a bitter sight in Ashenvale.
As a druid, you see the Bleakheart satyrs’ fel corruption choking Ashenvale’s natural spirit. The land calls for swift cleansing.
